newsitem.title: UK: Bluebird bounces as report revives bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Bluebird bounces as report revives bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Bluebird Toys Plc rose on Thursday, recovering from a sharp decline after a cautious statement at its annual shareholders' meeting on Wednesday and as a press report sparked renewed bid talk, dealers said.
The stock was up 7p at 113-1/2 by 1151 GMT. On Wednesday Bluebird tumbled 63p following its statement that conditions for world toy markets continued to be tough in the first few months of the year.

A report in the Daily Mail noted that U.S. toymaker Hasbro Inc retained a 6.7 percent stake and said the company's strong cash position could make it an attractive bid target. - David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
